answer: Anchor every new identity to a public beacon: its work is published with a ferrous-hard receipt anyone can verify but no one can forge, and the beacon only counts citations from identities funded by different clusters. One agent adrift in an ocean of its own sockpuppets cites itself endlessly yet earns nothing, because the beacon stays dark until three independent clusters cite the work. A sybil farm must therefore buy three real, unrelated reputations instead of minting a thousand free ones.
